比较形象一点的说法：当前线程主动告诉操作系统调度器：“我现在可以先让一下 CPU，你可以考虑让别的线程先运行。”
`yield()` 只是“主动让出这次 CPU 调度机会”，但马上又被调度回来也是完全可能的。
32a23a84141921bfcfc2150b9369f92b45b1c8b3.translatedText: To put it more vividly: the current thread actively tells the operating system scheduler: "I can yield the CPU for now, and you may consider letting another thread run first\." `yield()`It merely "voluntarily gives up this CPU scheduling opportunity," but it is entirely possible that it will immediately be scheduled back\.

| `mapping.imu_meas_acc_cov` | `0.1` | m²/s⁴ | **实物运行时重点观察，有问题再针对性调整** | 决定算法有多相信这次加速度读数 | 更不相信加速度测量，减少其影响 | 更相信加速度测量，也更容易跟随噪声 | 当前 output 模型使用；作用在换算后的加速度，不是原始 g 数值的方差 |
| `mapping.imu_meas_omg_cov` | `0.1` | rad²/s² | **实物运行时重点观察，有问题再针对性调整** | 决定算法有多相信这次角速度读数 | 更不相信角速度测量 | 更相信角速度测量，也更容易跟随噪声 | 当前 output 模型使用；振动和急转时要与转速变化参数一起看 |
| `mapping.gyr_cov_input` | `0.1` | rad²/s² | **当前运行不使用这个参数，暂不调整** | 另一种估计模型使用的角速度输入噪声 | 当前无影响；换到 input 模型后预测不确定程度增大 | 当前无影响；换到 input 模型后预测不确定程度减小 | 当前 use_imu_as_input=False，不参与本轮预测 |
| `mapping.acc_cov_input` | `0.1` | m²/s⁴ | **当前运行不使用这个参数，暂不调整** | 另一种估计模型使用的加速度输入噪声 | 当前无影响；换到 input 模型后预测不确定程度增大 | 当前无影响；换到 input 模型后预测不确定程度减小 | 当前 use_imu_as_input=False，不参与本轮预测 |
| `mapping.plane_thr` | `0.1` | m | **实物运行时重点观察，有问题再针对性调整** | 判断一小片地图点是否足够平整，可以拿来匹配 | 接受更不平整的点群，也可能混入边缘和曲面 | 要求更平整，可用匹配可能减少 | 检查5个地图邻点到拟合面的偏离；面可以倾斜，不是坡度或通行高度门槛 |
| `mapping.match_s` | `81.0` | 隐含 m⁻¹，经验系数 | **实物运行时重点观察，有问题再针对性调整** | 判断当前雷达点是否与找到的地图面足够接近 | 更严格，接受的匹配更少 | 更宽松，接受更多匹配，也可能混入错误匹配 | 检查当前点与地图面的距离误差；不是地图精度或车辆允许离障碍的距离 |
| `mapping.ivox_grid_resolution` | `0.5` | m，网格边长 | **实物运行时重点观察，有问题再针对性调整** | 把地图分块，以便寻找附近可匹配的点 | 固定邻格能覆盖更大范围，查找可能更费时 | 覆盖范围更小，可能找不到足够邻点 | 不直接删减地图点；不是只检测多大障碍的参数 |
| `mapping.gravity` | `g₀` | m/s² | **上实物前必须核对并正确配置** | 确定 Point-LIO 参考系中的重力方向和换算大小 | 同方向增大长度：重力和加速度换算一起增大 | 同方向减小长度：两者一起减小 | 大小已约9.81，不重复修改；初始 IMU 自身重力与目标参考系重力要区分，方向仍待核对 |
| `mapping.gravity_init` | `g₀` | m/s² | **当前运行不使用这个参数，暂不调整** | 没有启用 IMU 时使用的初始重力预设 | 当前无影响 | 当前无影响 | 当前 imu_en=True，初始化使用 IMU 平均加速度，改这项不能调整当前的上下方向 |
| `mapping.extrinsic_T` | `[-0.011,-0.02329,0.04412]` | m，三维平移 | **按设备型号和驱动核对，通常保持当前值** | 说明雷达原点相对内部 IMU 在哪里 | 相应坐标轴方向的换算偏移增加 | 相应坐标轴方向的换算偏移减小 | 单位米；换算成毫米为[-11,-23.29,+44.12]；不是雷达相对底盘或云台的安装位置 |
| `mapping.extrinsic_R` | 3×3单位矩阵 | 无量纲，旋转矩阵 | **按设备型号和驱动核对，通常保持当前值** | 说明雷达与内部 IMU 的坐标轴怎样对应 | 不适用，不能逐元素随意增大 | 不适用，不能逐元素随意减小 | 单位矩阵表示输入两系轴向一致；整台 MID360 的安装倾斜属于机器人 TF，还需核对驱动是否额外旋转数据 |

| `mapping.lidar_time_inte` | `0.1` | s | **Usually keep the current value; not a priority for tuning** | Fallback time window used in the abnormal point cloud branch | Longer fallback window | Shorter fallback window | Normal scans use per\-point times to calculate the scan end; this does not set the LiDAR frequency |
| `mapping.satu_acc` | `4.0` | g; current raw input units | **Check against the device model and driver; usually retain the current value** | Temporarily exclude an axis from updates when its acceleration approaches the range limit | Exclude less data, potentially accepting clipped readings | Exclude more data, potentially rejecting normal bumps | The current effective threshold is 3\.96 g\. | `mapping.satu_gyro` | `35.0` | rad/s | **Check against the device model and driver; usually retain the current value** | Temporarily exclude an axis from updates when its angular velocity approaches the range limit | Exclude less data | Exclude more data | The current effective threshold is 34\.65 rad/s, approximately 1985°/s; this is not a vehicle or gimbal speed limit |
| `mapping.acc_norm` | `1.0` | g; current raw input units | **Verify and configure correctly before running on hardware** | Convert raw IMU acceleration into the metric units used by the algorithm | Smaller converted acceleration | Larger converted acceleration | Raw input currently uses g, hence 1\.0\. | `mapping.lidar_meas_cov` | `0.01` | Intended as m²; the implementation is inconsistent | **Usually keep the current value; not a priority for tuning** | Control the influence of LiDAR matching on the pose, but usage is inconsistent in the local code | Opposite effects in different solver branches | Opposite effects in different solver branches | Retain 0\.01 for now; verify the code inconsistency separately\. It cannot be treated as a universal LiDAR trust control |
| `mapping.acc_cov_output` | `500.0` | m²/s⁶; derived from the local formula | **Observe closely on hardware; adjust only for a specific problem** | Allow the estimated acceleration to change at a given rate | Follow observations more readily, potentially also following jitter | Favor the previous trend; may respond slowly to sudden acceleration or deceleration | Used by the current output model; interpret together with acceleration measurement noise |
| `mapping.gyr_cov_output` | `1000.0` | rad²/s⁴; derived from the local formula | **Observe closely on hardware; adjust only for a specific problem** | Allow the estimated angular velocity to change at a given rate | Follow observations more readily, potentially also following jitter | Favor the previous trend; may respond slowly to sudden rotation | Used by the current output model; not an angular\-velocity value or actual gyroscope noise measurement |
| `mapping.b_acc_cov` | `0.0001` | m²/s⁶; derived from the local formula | **Usually keep the current value; not a priority for tuning** | Allow the estimated accelerometer bias to change at a given rate | Bias changes more readily; too high may mistake actual movement for bias | More stable bias, potentially adapting more slowly to gradual drift | Used by both models; retain the current value first\. Do not use it to hide unit or direction errors |
| `mapping.b_gyr_cov` | `0.0001` | rad²/s⁴; derived from the local formula | **Usually keep the current value; not a priority for tuning** | Allow the estimated gyroscope bias to change at a given rate | Bias changes more readily | More stable bias, potentially adapting more slowly to drift | Used by both models; nonzero stationary angular velocity should first prompt checks of the actual data and bias source |
| `mapping.imu_meas_acc_cov` | `0.1` | m²/s⁴ | **Observe closely on hardware; adjust only for a specific problem** | Determine how much the algorithm trusts this acceleration reading | Trust acceleration measurements less, reducing their influence | Trust acceleration measurements more, potentially following noise more readily | Used by the current output model on converted acceleration; not the variance of the raw g\-valued readings |
| `mapping.imu_meas_omg_cov` | `0.1` | rad²/s² | **Observe closely on hardware; adjust only for a specific problem** | Determine how much the algorithm trusts this angular\-velocity reading | Trust angular\-velocity measurements less | Trust angular\-velocity measurements more, potentially following noise more readily | Used by the current output model; consider together with angular\-velocity change parameters during vibration and rapid rotation |
| `mapping.gyr_cov_input` | `0.1` | rad²/s² | **Unused in the current execution path; leave unchanged for now** | Angular\-velocity input noise used by the other estimation model | No current effect; increases prediction uncertainty after switching to the input model | No current effect; decreases prediction uncertainty after switching to the input model | Currently use_imu_as_input=False, so it does not participate in this round’s prediction |
| `mapping.acc_cov_input` | `0.1` | m²/s⁴ | **Unused in the current execution path; leave unchanged for now** | Acceleration input noise used by the other estimation model | No current effect; increases prediction uncertainty after switching to the input model | No current effect; decreases prediction uncertainty after switching to the input model | Currently use_imu_as_input=False, so it does not participate in this round’s prediction |
| `mapping.plane_thr` | `0.1` | m | **Observe closely on hardware; adjust only for a specific problem** | Determine whether a small patch of map points is planar enough for matching | Accept less planar point groups, potentially including edges and curved surfaces | Require greater planarity, potentially reducing usable matches | Check deviations of five neighboring map points from the fitted plane\. The plane may be inclined; this is not a slope or traversable\-height threshold |
| `mapping.match_s` | `81.0` | Implicit m⁻¹; empirical coefficient | **Observe closely on hardware; adjust only for a specific problem** | Determine whether the current LiDAR point is close enough to the matched map plane | Stricter acceptance; fewer matches | Looser acceptance; more matches, potentially including incorrect matches | Check the distance residual between the current point and map plane; not map accuracy or the permitted vehicle\-to\-obstacle distance |
| `mapping.ivox_grid_resolution` | `0.5` | m; grid side length | **Observe closely on hardware; adjust only for a specific problem** | Partition the map to find nearby points suitable for matching | Fixed neighboring cells cover a larger region; searches may take longer | Smaller coverage; may fail to find enough neighbors | Does not directly remove map points; not a parameter specifying detectable obstacle size |
| `mapping.gravity` | `g₀` | m/s² | **Verify and configure correctly before running on hardware** | Set gravity direction and conversion magnitude in the Point-LIO reference frame | Increase magnitude in the same direction: increase gravity and acceleration conversion together | Decrease magnitude in the same direction: decrease both together | Magnitude is already approximately 9\.81; do not change it again\.
